note: boundcall-abba-1113 (PREPARED, NOT RUN; in the 2026-11-13 night chain it runs only if arm-ms --gate-on-slower bp,ip on jit-bundle-ab-1113 says ON is slower than OFF on BP or IP, or inconclusive; docs/537 §22, I-484-1): clean game recheck of [MonoJit] BoundCall. The 2026-11-13 in-load A/B (queues/boundcall.json, bp/ip-boundcall-ab) read +6.5 (BP) / +17 (IP) ms/s SLOWER, but with 2-min slices (about 2 usable slices per arm after the 15 s settle), off first and last (3 off / 2 on, sim time drifts with slice order), noise medium (8.7-10.9% of game CPUs, every row timing invalid), bcFills 4. Host bench says -166 ns per Dictionary<string,int>.TryGetValue, modelled 1.4-2.0 ms/s; a measured game loss beats a bench gain. Here: BP then IP, separate loads in ABBA order (off on on off), 10 min each, same seed, same asi (game-copy/ts3native.asi.boundcall-1113, sha256 74c64881, ts3native 0.36.250) and package (rc1111e), same ini; only MonoJit.BoundCallMask differs (0 vs 3; BoundCall=1, Direct=1, DirectLeaf=0, Mode=1 in all). No --ab, no samplers. Noise: queue.ts stops a job at >= 10% other CPU / clock drop and reruns it once at the end (<id>-rerun); a row with noise high or timing invalid does not count. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/boundcall-abba-1113.json (smoke runs first, ~12 min; 8 jobs x ~12 min, ~110 min total, more with noise reruns). Then: node tools/harness/arm-ms.ts boundcall-abba-1113, node tools/harness/run-verdict.ts boundcall-abba-1113, node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts. Decision: pooled on - off ms/s per world; ON only if on is not slower in both worlds and the two ABBA halves agree in sign; load drift shows as off1 vs off2 difference.

The OFF read-back (bcOn 0, bcHits 0) is proven by the first real job, which stops the queue on FAIL.
